platform.hero.title: Climate evidence, in the time it takes to read this line.
platform.hero.sub: Senseible turns any business document into a verified emission record, one that a lender can underwrite, a regulator can audit, and a buyer can rely on.
platform.what.title: A verification layer for climate data.
platform.what.body: Most climate numbers are self-reported. Senseible replaces the self-report with a chain of evidence (a hash, a methodology, a confidence band) that anyone downstream can independently check. It works on the documents a business already produces, in the language and the country the business already operates in.
platform.who.title: Six audiences. One verified record.
platform.who.msme.label: MSMEs & exporters
platform.who.msme.line: Turn invoices into a verified emission record, no consultant required.
platform.who.enterprise.label: Enterprises
platform.who.enterprise.line: Get Scope 3 supplier data that holds up under CBAM, ISSB and CSRD.
platform.who.lender.label: Banks & lenders
platform.who.lender.line: Underwrite against hash-pinned figures, not borrower self-declarations.
platform.who.policy.label: Policy & regulators
platform.who.policy.line: Read decision-grade signals tied to a methodology version you can audit.
platform.who.buyer.label: Carbon credit buyers
platform.who.buyer.line: Source MSME-origin credits that clear additionality and evidence linkage.
platform.who.partner.label: Ecosystem partners
platform.who.partner.line: Plug verified MSME climate data into your own product surface.
platform.problem.title: The verification gap in emerging-market climate data.
platform.problem.p1: Emerging-market supply chains carry most of the world's industrial emissions, and almost none of the verified data. Regulators ask for primary numbers. Buyers ask for primary numbers. Lenders ask for primary numbers. Without them, the default values apply, and the cost lands on the smallest producer.
platform.problem.p2: Senseible closes that gap by making verification cheap enough to do at the speed of business, in the language and identifier system of every market it touches.
platform.how.title: Three steps. Same record, used three ways.
platform.how.capture.title: Capture
platform.how.capture.body: Drop a document, take a photo, or speak the data point. The first response arrives in under two seconds.
platform.how.verify.title: Verify
platform.how.verify.body: Every document is hashed, parsed, classified deterministically, and reconciled against country grid factors.
platform.how.use.title: Use
platform.how.use.body: The verified record feeds your disclosure, your lender, your reduction roadmap, and, when eligible, your credits.
platform.out.eyebrow: What you can do with verified data
platform.out.title: Four outcomes, one ledger.
platform.out.report.title: Report
platform.out.report.body: One verified ledger serves CBAM, BRSR, GHG Protocol, ISSB, CSRD, TCFD, GRI and SBTi without re-keying.
platform.out.finance.title: Finance
platform.out.finance.body: Verified baselines and a Climate Credibility Score become underwriting inputs for green loans and factoring.
platform.out.decarbonize.title: Decarbonize
platform.out.decarbonize.body: A baseline becomes a sector-aware roadmap. Reductions are tracked against the original methodology, not re-baselined.
platform.out.monetize.title: Monetize
platform.out.monetize.body: Records that clear additionality, evidence linkage and methodology lock can become credit-ready signals for buyers.
platform.trust.title: Trust, in one line.
platform.trust.body: Every figure carries its SHA-256 evidence hash, its methodology version, its confidence band, and a Climate Credibility Score from A+ to D.

careers.life.title: We aren't just building climate technology. We're removing what stands between small businesses and the green economy.
careers.life.sub: Compressing months of proof into seconds, so being clean pays, instead of costing. This is where that work happens.
careers.why.a.b: MRV that used to take a consultant a quarter now clears from a single upload. The work you ship compresses time for millions of businesses.
careers.why.b.b: Compliance stops being a burden and becomes a payout. Green invoices, factoring, credits: proof that being clean pays.
careers.why.c.b: Verification cheap enough to reach every MSME across ten emerging markets, in eleven languages. This is the scale we're built for.
careers.belong.title: You bring a life, a language, a way of seeing the problem we haven't seen yet. We hire for that, not around it.
careers.belong.a.b: We ship in eleven languages because the people using this platform don't all think in English. If yours isn't listed yet, help us add it.
careers.belong.b.h: Your background is a feature, not a footnote.
careers.belong.b.b: Self-taught, graduate, career-switcher, PhD, first job: the problem is too big for one kind of resume. Show us how you think.
careers.belong.c.h: Your discipline is welcome across surfaces.
careers.belong.c.b: Engineer, researcher, designer, operator, writer, policy mind: every one of them touches this product. None of them are ornamental.
careers.belong.d.h: Your distance from us is not the point.
careers.belong.d.b: Gurugram, Remote (India), or Hybrid today, with the discipline to work asynchronously well. We hire for judgement, not proximity.
careers.work.title: Four surfaces. Each one shipped by someone who owns it end-to-end.
careers.work.mrv.b: Deterministic carbon math on real documents. OCR, HSN-to-scope, evidence hashing, methodology versioning. Numbers that survive audit.
careers.work.finance.b: Turn verified baselines into underwriting inputs for green loans, factoring, and SLLs, with a credibility score a lender can read.
careers.work.ai.b: Document extraction, Scope 3 inference, multilingual voice for owners who don't type in English. Production traffic, not demos.
careers.work.trust.b: Immutable evidence, greenwashing prevention, framework mapping (CBAM, BRSR, GHG Protocol, ISSB, CSRD, TCFD). The audit case for everything upstream.
careers.do.a: We ship the week you join.
careers.do.c: We say yes or no in two weeks.
careers.do.d: We argue with data and move.
careers.dont.d: We don't defend decisions with seniority.
careers.dont.e: We don't dress up perks as a salary.
careers.faq.a1: No. We need strong builders who care. The carbon and finance context is teachable in weeks; the taste for hard problems is not.
careers.faq.q2: I'm a fresher or intern. How do I apply?
careers.faq.a2: Use the freshers and interns form on this page. It goes to the founding team. Reply within a week, usually faster.
careers.faq.a3: Market-competitive base for the stage, meaningful ESOPs, performance incentives. No unlimited-leave theatre. We move fast because we're resource-conscious, not resource-loose.
careers.faq.a4: Roles are Gurugram, Hybrid, or Remote (India) today. We hire for outcomes and judgement, not desks.
careers.faq.q5: Do you sponsor visas or relocation?
careers.faq.a5: Not today. We revisit as we grow. If you're extraordinary and outside India, still write. We'll be honest about what's possible.
careers.faq.q6: What does day one actually look like?
careers.faq.a6: You ship something real. A pipeline change, a design pass, a research note, a partner conversation. No manufactured onboarding.

home.cbam.lead: Estimated CBAM cost your EU buyer pays per tonne of {sector} from India
home.cbam.toggle: My buyer has my verified emissions data
home.cbam.note_verified: Using {intensity} tCO2 per tonne ({route}) with no mark-up.
home.cbam.note_default: Without your data the buyer uses a default value of {intensity} tCO2 per tonne plus a mark-up (10% in 2026, 20% in 2027, 30% from 2028).
home.cbam.countdown: days until the first CBAM declaration is due (30 September 2027)
home.how.1.title: Capture
home.how.1.body: Upload an electricity bill, fuel slip or invoice, or take a photo. Each line item is read and classified to Scope 1, 2 or 3.
home.how.2.title: Multiply
home.how.2.body: Every line is multiplied by a published emission factor. One kWh of Indian grid power is 0.710 kgCO2 (CEA CO2 Baseline Database v21.0).
home.how.3.title: Verify
home.how.3.body: Each document is hashed so it cannot be counted twice. More evidence narrows the uncertainty band, roughly with the square root of the number of records.
home.how.4.title: Use it
home.how.4.body: Take the same verified record to a green loan application, a buyer or export request, or a carbon credit check.
home.problem.title: Your bills already hold your carbon data.
home.problem.body: Banks, buyers and carbon markets now ask small businesses for verified emissions. Senseible turns the invoices and energy bills you already keep into a verified record you can take to a green loan, a buyer or a carbon credit check.
home.how.title: From an invoice to finance-ready data
home.cbam.title: Exporting to the EU? What CBAM costs your buyer
home.cbam.sub: Since 1 January 2026, EU importers owe a certificate for each tonne of CO2 embedded in these goods, above a shrinking free allowance. Verified data from you is the cheapest way down.
home.act.title: Start with one bill.
home.act.body: Free audit-ready carbon report from your first bill.

ent.hero.title: Every supplier's emissions, in one record you can defend.
ent.hero.line: Scope 3 programmes stall on supplier chasing and spreadsheets that never reconcile. Senseible collects what suppliers already have, ties each figure to its source document, and keeps estimates labelled until real data replaces them, so reporting holds up as your supplier base grows.
ent.hero.status: Live today: documents to verified records. Custom: integrations and supplier-network features built to your requirements. Every capability on this page is labelled.
